notes.title: Satelum Demo "Behavior Machine" Completes First Playtest- Thanks for Wishlist !
notes.content: [h2][b]Thank you for adding us to your wishlist![/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]On [b]June 21st, 2025[/b], the [i]Behavior Machine[/i] demo of [b]Satelum[/b] had its [b]very first hands-on public playtest[/b] — and received [b]enthusiastic feedback[/b] from players![/h3][h3]Everyone who joined the demo received a [b]Satelum-themed souvenir[/b].[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]We gathered [b]over 50 wishlists[/b] during the event — a milestone that [b]means a lot to us[/b]![/h3][h3][/h3][h3]While continuing development on the full version, we’ll [b]keep polishing this demo[/b] and plan to showcase it [b]at a future Next Fest[/b] as a playable preview.[/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656782/19275f979a946bba172c650d28db64be03070c55.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656782/f184247c3f868ba194cb223c39676055d7876618.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656782/0a7e43f1aab03280c7229dc81f0762b9439b05c3.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656782/caa3e6500f0122259d2f9ad45638c68b6835c24b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656782/8161973be4feaf59a124072bd2dd3a9b020e9013.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]※ These photos were captured during the event and are shared only for community documentation.[/p][p][/p][h3]Thank you for your trust and support from the very beginning.[/h3][h3][i][b]Stay tuned![/b][/i][/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]06/30/2025[/h3][h3]By Jia-Yi-Bing-Ping![/h3]
